title: A counterexample to Ryser's covering conjecture

abstractEnglish: For every sufficiently large prime $`s\equiv2\pmod3`$ and every sufficiently large odd integer n, with the threshold depending on s, we construct an intersecting $`(s^n+1)`$-partite $`(s^n+1)`$-uniform hypergraph with covering number $`s^n+1`$. This disproves Ryser's covering conjecture in its intersecting case.
titleEn: A counterexample to Ryser's covering conjecture
